text:
zara-cs: Quick sync: HarborHealth renewal coming up. Customer asked to shorten the term to 6 months and add a mid-term true-up clause. They also requested invoices be sent to a shared procurement mailbox and asked for our standard delegated-signer language. Need legal + finance input: revenue recognition and credit exposure.

lee-acct: Current ARR $24,000 (120 seats). Proposed: 6mo term, monthly invoices Net30, mid-term true-up for seat increase at 3 months. Any discounts for shorter term?

zara-cs: Customer asked for no discount; they prefer flexibility. They emphasized faster start and lower cash outlay.

marco-legal: Shortening term is fine but true-up clause must specify measurement date and timing for invoice adjustment. Delegated-signer ok but limited to invoice receipt only. Need to ensure mailbox signing isn't treated as delegation unless they provide named delegates. Also require explicit PO number and email acceptance policy.

nina-finance: Finance flagged risk: shorter term + monthly billing increases AR churn. Need credit-app if expected exposure >$30k. For 6mo at current ARR that's $12k exposure so we're okay. For mid-term true-up, we need a manifest to compute prorated charges and timing for credit/charge. Also note: monthly invoices increase bank fees.

billing-bot: Billing note: monthly Net30 supported. To send to shared mailbox we need an invoice recipient override in subscription. That requires a small billing ops ticket. Please provide mailbox address and PO metadata.

docsign-bot: Prepared envelope 1789993400 "HarborHealth 6mo True-up Addendum" awaiting legal redline.

zara-cs: HarborHealth billing mailbox: procure@harborhealth.org; PO will be provided after delegate names confirmed. I'll ask customer for named delegates and requested measurement and true-up cadence.

lee-acct: If they opt for no discount and monthly billing, ensure MRR is tracked in our system for renewal forecasting. Also check whether enablement wants a shorter onboarding batch.

marco-legal: I'll draft wording: true-up measured on day 90 +/- 5 business days, invoice to reflect additional seats prorated for remainder of term, payment due Net30. Delegated-signer: require named delegates or a signed letter from procurement.

nina-finance: Sounds good. No credit-app required given exposure. Approve draft once posted.

zara-cs: Great. I'll collect delegates and PO. Sending in Gainsight as "pending signature".
